title: CARGO: Causal Attribution and Responsibility-Guided Preventive Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Cooperative Driving
title_zh: CARGO：面向协同驾驶的因果归因与责任引导的预防性安全多智能体强化学习

paragraphs.en: 提出CARGO多智能体强化学习框架，通过因果归因与责任引导优化协同匝道汇入，显著提升成功率并降低碰撞率。 This study presents Causal Attribution and Responsibility-Guided Optimization (CARGO), a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for cooperative on-ramp merging in mixed traffic. A shared latent-context posterior and an action-conditioned response model estimate directed behavioral influence, with posterior uncertainty propagated into interaction-edge selection. Complementary attribution mechanisms couple signed influence with marginal team utility for cooperative reward shaping and assign responsibility from positive excess tail risk relative to a safe reference policy. Conditional diffusion generates future responses for action-dependent risk estimation. Responsibility-guided preventive optimization calibrates agent-specific risk-reduction requirements to local capacity within a policy trust region, using reserved safety margins, adaptive requirement scaling, and joint feasibility verification. Theoretical analysis establishes risk monotonicity and sufficient local conditions for non-decreasing environmental return under explicit assumptions. Experiments in highway-env across three traffic densities, together with controlled graph-recovery and attribution studies, support the effectiveness of the framework. Under high-density traffic, CARGO increases the success rate by 66.04\% and reduces the crash rate by 56.23\% relative to the best evaluated baseline for each metric.
paragraphs.zh: 提出CARGO多智能体强化学习框架，通过因果归因与责任引导优化协同匝道汇入，显著提升成功率并降低碰撞率。本研究提出因果归因与责任引导优化（CARGO），一个面向混合交通中协同匝道汇入的多智能体强化学习框架。 共享的潜在情境后验与动作条件响应模型用于估计有向行为影响，并将后验不确定性传播到交互边选择中。 互补的归因机制将带符号影响与边际团队效用耦合以进行协同奖励塑形，并相对于安全参考策略根据正超额尾部风险分配责任。 条件扩散模型生成未来响应以进行动作相关的风险估计。 责任引导的预防性优化在策略信任域内，利用预留安全裕度、自适应需求缩放与联合可行性验证，将智能体特定的风险降低需求校准到局部通行能力。 理论分析在明确假设下建立了风险单调性以及环境回报不递减的充分局部条件。 在highway-env中跨三种交通密度的实验，以及受控的图恢复与归因研究，支持了该框架的有效性。 在高密度交通下，相对于每个指标下评估的最优基线，CARGO将成功率提升66.04\%，并将碰撞率降低56.23\%。
